selected_segment.rerun_note: The recorded deterministic command was executed twice with the same input and options: pass 1 produced the frames, and pass 2 was run solely to replace the initial PowerShell-decorated showinfo capture with an undecorated log, rewriting the same filenames. Only one canonical frame set exists; no variant was retained or selected from.
selected_segment.shot: Continuous diner dialogue take; Johnny Silverhand seated in a booth speaking to the player. No cut inside the selected range.

canonical_frames.naming: frame_000000.png … frame_000179.png; index equals PTS order

color_handling.notes: Explicit BT.709 limited-range 10-bit YUV to full-range RGB24 via swscale. No zscale, tone mapping, gamma change, resize, crop, denoise, or sharpening.

video_roi.purpose: Fixed face/upper-body analysis ROI selected from the first canonical frame; metadata and inspection only, not a model-input crop.
video_roi.validation_grid_sampling: 13 frames at indices 0,15,30,...,165 plus index 179, i.e. every 0.5 s across the six-second range
video_roi.validation_note: Johnny Silverhand's head, long hair, face, sunglasses, beard, and upper body remain fully inside the fixed rectangle in the first, middle, and last frames and in the 13-sample validation grid. No frame was cropped for the canonical frames or for model input.

selected_dialogue_10s_16s_h264.mp4.reason_not_used: Re-encoded H.264 derivative; canonical frames were decoded directly from the source HEVC MOV to avoid generation loss.

transformations: Canonical frames: FFmpeg 9.0.2 decoded source PTS [10.000,16.000) to native 3840x2160 RGB24 full-range PNG with explicit swscale in_range=tv, in_color_matrix=bt709, out_range=pc, out_color_matrix=bt709, format=rgb24. No resize, crop, denoise, sharpening, tone mapping, or frame interpolation.
Frame selection: select='gte(t,10.000)*lt(t,16.000)' with -fps_mode passthrough; exactly 180 consecutive source frames, no duplication or drop.

The 1024x1024 video ROI is metadata/inspection only. ROI contact sheet, validation grid, and head crops were derived from canonical PNGs for review; canonical frames and model inputs were not cropped.

methodology.device_requirement: SM120 (12.0) explicit check; the four arms are pinned to that lease
methodology.shared: same valid geometry, same source frame for GPU scopes, same fixed noise seed for both models
methodology.stateless: empty history/motion/depth/conditioning/blend for every measured frame
methodology.trunk_only: prepared RGB trunk sequence (185 legacy / 109 Small logical calls; all plan descriptors reused except the final phase-3 C32 output view) on precomputed real pooled input; b69 is plane16, NOT a video FPS. plan.run_* remains a separate tile4 diagnostic and is not timed
methodology.full_gpu: preprocess + RGB plane16 trunk + postprocess on the current stream, including native per-launch texture/surface D2D copies; excludes H2D/D2H and encoder
methodology.validation: typed packed-low FP16 Half / FP8 E4M3 non-finite check runs before post in renderer paths and in each arm's preflight; every timed closure disables it after that preflight; CUDA graph capture requires it disabled
methodology.cpu_wall: host wall from RGB PNG decode/convert through upload, full GPU, synchronize and valid RGB D2H; encoder excluded
methodology.timing: CUDA events with end.synchronize() per interval; CPU perf_counter across explicit synchronize boundaries
methodology.statistics: median/p10/p90/mean/min/max plus FPS derived from the median within each scope
methodology.allocation: plan, records, records packing, frontends, the RGB sequence and buffers are prepared outside every timed loop; no repack kernel or second field
methodology.before_timing: two validating replays hashed equal, finite [0,1] RGB, alpha 1, typed low state finite, plan guards intact; a lossless validation PNG is written
methodology.guards: plan.guards_intact() checked before and after every timed arm

support_limits: RGB-only stateless mode: history, motion, depth, conditioning and blend are empty for every frame; the native preprocess copies current colour into its history feature lanes.
No motion, depth or conditioning G-buffer is reconstructed; the constant conditioning and fixed session noise are neutral defaults, not renderer inputs.
No temporal, zero-motion quality or optical-flow mode is implemented or claimed.
Original is the decoded source frame, not an NVIDIA DLL/vendor reference.
No vendor parity, no image-quality score and no claim that either model is closer to the original.
Small31 post phase 0 is the model-spec default; its host dispatch is source-derived and not verified against DLL host descriptors.
The benchmark measures this reconstructed native host, not an original NGX/DLSS execution.
Media is published only from the approved profile output; third-party media is not redistributed by this harness.
No license, endorsement, copyright or source URL is inferred; only values supplied to --source-metadata are recorded.
A still-image run is a single decoded frame, not a video; it never encodes or publishes an MP4.

reproduction.render: Re-run the exact 'argv' list above with --mode render; for a single still this writes PNGs only and never invokes ffmpeg.
reproduction.benchmark: Re-run the exact 'argv' list above with --mode benchmark on the SM120 lease; a still benchmark replays the same decoded frame.

benchmark_support_limits: These are reconstructed native host timings, not an original NGX/DLSS benchmark.
No vendor parity, quality score or close-to-original claim is made.
The CPU wall scope includes decode/convert/H2D/D2H; the GPU scopes exclude them.
The frontend's hidden D2D texture/surface copies are included in full GPU and excluded from trunk-only.
trunk_only is the prepared RGB plane16 sequence (final phase-3 C32 output view); the untouched plan.run_* tile4 layout is a separate diagnostic and is never the timed path.

Typed packed-low validation is a diagnostic failure path, not output repair; it runs before post in renderer paths and before each arm's timing, and is disabled inside every timed closure after that preflight.
Small31 post phase 0 is the model-spec default; its host dispatch is source-derived and not DLL-verified.
Clock/power sampling is best-effort and has no hard dependency.
